# TopologyAware_SynapticMapping

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A mapping strategy that assigns synaptic connections to physical links based on topological proximity and traffic locality in the interconnect. Reduces routing congestion and latency in TCC, directly impacting the performance of distributed neural computations.
